title: The pipeline deploys its own roles and account stacks on merge
description:
```gherkin
Feature: Merge deploys the account's stacks

  Scenario: A merge to the release branch applies changed stacks
    Given a stack template changed in a commit merged to the release branch
    When the account-stacks workflow runs
    Then it signs in with GitHub OIDC and creates a change set per changed stack
    And it executes only change sets that remove or replace nothing that is not allow-listed

  Scenario: Changing the account baseline needs an approval
    Given a merged change to the account baseline stack
    When the workflow finds it differs from the live stack
    Then the roles job waits for a person to approve the protected GitHub environment
    And the ordinary deploy role cannot change that stack

  Scenario: A pull request shows the plan with read-only access
    Given a pull request that changes a stack
    When CI runs
    Then the templates are linted with no AWS access
    And the plan is read with a role that can create nothing
```
